claim.claim-text: 1. A method for manufacturing a substantially cylindrical dust cover (6) covering an outer side of a damper (3) extending in a predetermined direction and including bellows portions (61) that are configured to expand and contract in an axial direction and a flange portion (63) that extends radially outward,

wherein an inner wall surface (110) of a mold (100) used in blow molding has a recess (130) corresponding to the flange portion (63), and wherein the mold (100) has a variable mechanism that changes an axial dimension of the recess (130) between a primary molding distance and a final molding distance, the final molding distance corresponding to a thickness of the flange portion (63), and the primary molding distance being larger than the final molding distance, the method for manufacturing the dust cover (6) comprising:
2. The method for manufacturing a dust cover (6) according to claim 1,

wherein the mold (100) includes a first mold (101) corresponding to one side in the axial direction of the flange portion (63) in the dust cover (6), and a second mold (102) corresponding to the other side in the axial direction of the flange portion (63) in the dust cover (6) and configured to move relative to the first mold (101) in the axial direction, and wherein the recess (130) of the inner wall surface (110) is formed by combining inner wall surfaces (111, 121) of the first mold (101) and the second mold (102), and the axial dimension of the recess (130) is changed by a movement of the second mold (102) relative to the first mold (101) in the axial direction.
